versions.text: Criterion: Verify the performance of the fire suppression system. Standard: The fire suppression system provides agent concentrations and duration levels that extinguish a fire under all ground and flight conditions. Method of Compliance: Hazard analysis determines the need for a fire extinguishing system for each designated fire zone. Analysis establishes agent concentrations and duration levels that extinguish a fire. Ground and flight testing verifies that the appropriate agent concentrations are present under all ground and flight conditions.
